notes.title: Magret and Facedebouc are looking forward to seeing you!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44727920/1c9f41e261b853cf1b31ddd2b41022461a28bd24.jpg[/img][h1]The final and definitive version of Magret & Facedebouc is ready for launch, and is only waiting for July 16, 2024 to offer itself to you! [/h1]

[Feedback from beta testers [/b]who had the advantage of playing the full game while tracking down bugs, has been a success! Many improvements have been made to the game thanks to them, and I can't thank them enough.

I'd also like to thank once again all those who gave their financial support during the Kickstarter campaign, aimed at funding a translator to provide a much cleaner English version than an online site.
As a reward, each backer on Kickstarter received a key to play the game in preview from July 1, 2024, as well as the digital Artbook, depending on their commitment to the project.

[h2]Let's get on with the investigation into Monsieur Couane's murder![/h2]
Magret et Facedebouc is now ready and waiting for [b]the release date of July 16, 2024[/b] to offer this fantastic point-and-click adventure, set in a cartoon universe, with colorful characters and an exciting investigation, with an approximate playing time of between 5 and 7 hours.

[The game will cost €14.99, but will benefit from a 10% discount during the first week of launch...[/b].
If you haven't already done so, don't miss this opportunity to add the game to your wishlist and take advantage of the offer when it's released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780/ 

[h3]See you on July 16, 2024 for new adventures, and don't forget that a free demo of the start of the adventure is available on the store page![/h3]

notes.title: Magret & Facedebouc game to be released on 16 July 2024!
notes.content:
[MAGRET & FACEDEBOUC will be released on Steam on TUESDAY 16 JULY 2024[/h1].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44727920/1c9f41e261b853cf1b31ddd2b41022461a28bd24.jpg[/img]
I'm delighted to announce that the definitive release date for Magret & Facedebouc has been set for mid-July, on the 16th to be precise!
The game is currently available as a [b]private early access[/b] to certain Betatesteurs, the video game press and as a reward to all those who supported the crowdfunding.

Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] as this is very important for its visibility when it is released.
Click here to do so: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780/[/url]

By the way, I invite you to [b]understand why adding it to your wishlist is so important for a game[/b], by reading this article on the Adipson Studio website: 
[url=https://adipson-studio.com/index.php/2023/12/26/a-simple-review-from-you-can-change-the-future-of-grandma-badass/]https://adipson-studio.com/index.php/2023/12/26/a-simple-review-from-you-can-change-the-future-of-grandma-badass/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44727920/216ce1dfaa1bc72c343a39146c881454eda8451a.jpg[/img]
Feedback on the game from betatesters has been [u]promising and dithyrambic[/u], so all point and click fans can look forward to an exciting and incredible adventure in a game lasting [b]at least 3 hours[/b] (between 4 and 6 hours on average, according to tests). 

Point-and-click purists will be able to play the game with their mouse, but it can also be played with any controller (PC, Xbox Serie X/S/360/one and Playstation 4/5).

notes.title: The Magret & Facedebouc demo is available for this new SteamNextFest!
notes.content:
[h1]MAGRET & FACEDEBOUC DEMO NOW AVAILABLE![/h1]

[h2]Steam's demo festival (SteamNextFest 2024) is a unique opportunity to present Magret & Facedebouc, a point and click game currently in development and scheduled for release in the second quarter of 2024. [/h2]

This free playable demo lets you jump straight into the adventure of this unlikely duo, made up of two unusual detectives. 
Take on the role of a refined, bourgeois green-necked duck, and alternate with an impulsive, vindictive goat, to investigate the crime of a shopkeeper, Mr Couane, a pig found chopped up and turned into sausages in his coffee shop in the early hours of the morning... 

[b]Questioning suspects, solving riddles and finding clues to analyse will be your priorities in this totally madcap game, where dialogue and humour have pride of place.[/b]
It's a game that breaks the 4th wall, with the characters sometimes mocking you directly when you make absurd choices or choices that don't go the way of the detectives...

Just try to finish the prologue and you'll get an idea of the atmosphere that awaits you in this game, which should offer you [b]between 3 and 4 hours of crazy adventures[/b] when it's released.

The demo: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780[/url]

notes.title: Magret & FaceDeBouc land on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Imagine living in a cartoon town and controlling two crazy police detectives...[/h1]

[b]Magret[/b],  a manic, neurotic green-necked duck, has to team up with [b]FaceDeBouc[/b], an impulsive, temperamental goat, to investigate the crime of Mr[b] Couane[/b], a shopkeeper pig who has been partially transformed into a sausage...
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44727920/6d5147a8f867de44b72f550297cf3084f5c43f1f.png[/img]
This is the pitch for the pilot episode of what could be, if the game is a hit with you, a wild saga spanning several investigations and several years.

[h2]Add the game to your wishlist![/h2]
It's very important to motivate me to continue developing this game...
And to do that... well, you'll have to show me that you're interested.
There are two ways of doing this: 
Support the Kickstarter campaign or add the game to your wishlist!
[b]
Go to the steam page[/b] of this new game from the Adipson studio, which should be released in April 2024, and above all...add it to your wishlist before sharing it on all your social networks to give it a chance of getting more views than Grandma Badass, which suffered from a cruel lack of visibility as soon as it was released...
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661780/[/url]
